source.author: verg
source.text: Ipse ratem conto subigit, velisque ministrat, et ferruginea subvectat corpora cymba, iam senior, sed cruda deo viridisque senectus.
source.text_original: Ipse ratem conto subigit, velisque ministrat, / et ferruginea subvectat corpora cymba, / iam senior, sed cruda deo viridisque senectus.
source.text_english: He himself propels the boat with a pole and attends to the sails, and ferries the bodies across in a dark-hued skiff, now old, but to the god his old age is fresh and green.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: tu sola animos mentesque peruris, Gloria; te viridem videt immunemque senectae Phasidis in ripa stantem iuvenesque vocantem.
reuse.text_original: tu sola animos mentesque peruris, / Gloria; te viridem videt immunemque senectae / Phasidis in ripa stantem iuvenesque vocantem.
reuse.text_english: you alone, Glory, burn up minds and hearts; the Phasis sees you standing on its bank, green and free from old age, and calling the young men.
